title: BBC Tests Autonomous Uber Ride in London
seoTitle: BBC Tries Autonomous Uber in London
subtitle: BBC's Zoe Kleinman takes a ride in an Uber robotaxi as the service launches
excerpt: BBC journalist Zoe Kleinman experiences Uber's robotaxi as the company rolls out its new autonomous service in London.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
BBC journalist Zoe Kleinman took part in a test ride, boarding an Uber robotaxi as the company launches its service in London.

The fully autonomous vehicle navigated the streets of the British capital, driven by Uber's technology, with no human driver present at the wheel.

This demonstration marks the launch phase of Uber's autonomous transport service, allowing passengers to experience this new form of urban mobility.

With information from BBC News.
